_README: Location-scoped scenarios over the reference deployment's anonymized registry
(prod_registry_anonymized.json, July 2026 snapshot). Every other ground truth
has an empty context, so the protocol 0.5 rule that a location restricts where
an intent acts was never measured. The scenarios are the deployment operator's:
light_on_presence is the class that deployment runs in production, and the
places are the ones its operator gave its devices -- in this snapshot, as
location tags, which protocol 0.5 still honours by exact match. The protocol
imposes no vocabulary for places. What is measured is the rule, not the
placement. In this deployment the operator and the protocol's author are the

light_on_presence.description: Turn on the lights where presence was detected

cases._note_direction: Protocol 0.5 rev. 2026-10-02: control_access asks for lock and unlock, so an intent must say which (context.action_types). This ground truth is per device: the lock acts either way, so the direction chosen here cannot change any result. 'lock' is used.
